result.prior_version_note: As originally adopted by Ord. 25-057 (final passage May 21, 2025; Mayor approved May 22, 2025), § 218-12(2)(a) barred real estate lessors, agents or subcontractors from subscribing to, contracting with, or otherwise exchanging anything of value in return for the services of a Service Provider. Ord. 25-076 (adopted July 16, 2025; Mayor approved July 17, 2025) added 'or otherwise utilize' the services of a Service Provider. The § 218-12(2)(b) bar on service providers facilitating agreements not to compete was unchanged. Neither ordinance states an effective date. The June 2025 date for the original version comes only from a secondary law-firm alert and is month-only, and no effective date is given for the amended version.
